name: Amy Evans
source:
Amy is one of two Unique girls on the Island. She is in her mid-20's and before coming to the
island was a fitness coach. She is from Munich, Germany but is fluent in both English and German. She currently has the highest number of Scenes/Events/Achievements of any of the girls at 131.
